//: Turbo runs tasks in strict env mode: a variable not named here is invisible to them. Connection strings and signing keys go in passThrough rather than globalEnv because they must not become part of a cache key — the build output does not depend on which database it will talk to or which secret it will sign with, and secrets do not belong in a hash. On the `openapi` task: it writes apps/api/openapi.json and compiles apps/api to do it, so it needs @moodnight/db built first exactly as `build` does — which is the whole reason it is a turbo task and not a plain pnpm script. It is uncached because the document it writes lives inside the package it writes it from, making the task its own cache input; it runs on demand, not on every build.
